step.name: Block in the sky
step.technique: broken horizontal strokes with visible brush texture; blue at the top grading to orange near the horizon; crisp edge along the mountain ridge and trees
step.success: sky fully covered down to the mountain ridge and around the trees, values match the reference. Earlier steps are already painted; later steps' areas are intentionally still bare

correct.note: step fully painted exactly as the reference

wrong_value.note: paint is far too dark; should be lighter

missed_region.note: bare-canvas patch inside the step's region

wrong_stroke_dir.note: brush texture rotated 90 degrees from the step's 0 deg

overblended.note: smooth blurry paint, no stroke texture

incomplete.note: right colors but only the top ~45% of the region is painted
